caveats.statement: Event status values may be stored with inconsistent casing or synonyms, so filtering on 'Closed' can miss events.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld007, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld007

caveats.statement: Budget variance sign convention may vary; negative values may indicate over-budget, so MIN is not always the worst overspend.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT MIN(fld022), MAX(fld022), COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld022 < 0

caveats.statement: Phone numbers may be stored with different formatting, so exact string matching can miss members.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld009 FROM tab02 WHERE fld009 NOT LIKE '___-___-____' LIMIT 10

evidence.result: [["Outdoor Product Design and Development"], ["Agricultural Communication"], ["Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences"]]

caveats.statement: T-shirt size values may use abbreviations (M vs Medium), so filtering only on 'Medium' can undercount.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld039, COUNT(*) FROM tab08 GROUP BY fld039

caveats.statement: Event names may have inconsistent spelling/casing, so joins on event name can fail.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld002, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld002 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

caveats.statement: Expense approval flag may be null or use varied encodings, so approved-only totals can be wrong.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld029, COUNT(*) FROM tab06 GROUP BY fld029
